login.title: Sign In to System
login.subtitle: Select your role and enter account credentials to continue.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot Password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email or identifier code to receive an OTP verification code to reset your password.
forgotPassword.successNotification: OTP verification code has been sent to your account!

verifyOtp.title: Verify OTP Code
verifyOtp.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit OTP code sent to {{identifier}}.
verifyOtp.resendSuccess: A new OTP code has been sent!

resetPassword.title: Reset New Password
resetPassword.subtitle: Create a new secure password for your account.
resetPassword.successNotification: Password changed successfully! Please sign in again.
resetPassword.backToLogin: Cancel and return to Sign In
